dialogues.speaker: Outsider Shrine
dialogues.text: (You can hear fireflies buzzing not far away. The little creatures crackle soothingly. You try to listen, but nothing happens.)

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: How is it? Were you fortunate enough to hear "his" teachings?

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: Ah, it is alright. It is alright. "He" sees. "He" hears.

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: "He" is comforted, and those who delight in "him" shall be rewarded.

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: "His" reward is not on yonder shore. It is tomorrow.

choices.text: Do you know what you're talking about?

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: Next time you're here, you can see for yourself.

choices.text: Excuse my shallowness, but I do not understand you.
I have not had the fortune to hear anything.

dialogues.speaker: Outsider Shrine
dialogues.text: (Yashiori Island has withered away due to the war, and it is a sad sight. But here, the empty tranquility lends vitality to nature. You try to listen, but nothing happens.)

dialogues.speaker: Outsider Shrine
dialogues.text: (It looks like an ordinary shrine — there is a distinct lack of any strange elemental traces.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue to pay respects

dialogues.speaker: Outsider Shrine
dialogues.text: (You can hear lizards running, and you can see the tiny, bamboo leaf-like footprints they leave, elegant yet transient. You try to listen, but nothing happens.)

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: Worship, listen...

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: "He" is strong because "he" listens. "He" sees and hears everything because "he" is strong. Thus "he" sees all there is. Hears all there is.

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: Neither the fools in Sangonomiya nor the madmen of Narukami Island understand it, feel it. So all they know is to fight each other and let the blood blind their eyes...

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: But you must understand that.

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: The answer lies in worship.

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: Remember. Worship three times a day and you shall be rewarded.

choices.text: I get it, more or less.

dialogues.text: (Washizu struggles to calm his restless mind, breathing heavily. He is obviously in a state of passion and seems to be expecting something. You try to listen, but nothing happens.)

dialogues.speaker: Outsider Shrine

dialogues.speaker: Outsider Shrine
dialogues.text: (Washizu is not completely insane. He obviously desires something, but what is this desire? Thinking only invites more questions. You try to listen, but nothing happens.)

dialogues.speaker: Outsider Shrine
dialogues.text: (You hear the sound of the waves crashing against the rocks, and that cascading sound leads people to gaze out at the place where sea and sky meet. You try to listen, but nothing happens.)

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: "He" must be calmed. "His" anger must be soothed...

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: You've done well! You've done very well!

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: Remember, some will try to cheat you with masks, but "he" will help you. "He" will always help you.

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: That woman is like the kitsune demons of legend. I let her go. "He" is very angry.

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: "He" is angry again... This is my sin.

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: Please forgive me... I will sacrifice again. I will find a sacrifice for the "returning"...

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: Please forgive me, please forgive me...

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: Please forgive me, please forgive me...

dialogues.speaker: Outsider Shrine
dialogues.text: (This looks like a common shrine with no special features. Seeing Washizu in this state, do you still want to keep paying respects at this shrine?)

dialogues.text: (Washizu is still muttering to himself by the side, and he doesn't look well at all. The shrine is still and unresponsive. Perhaps this is all a scam? You try to listen, but nothing happens.)

dialogues.text: (You hear the wind whistling through the great serpent's bones, but the ancient corpse remains still. It seems to have been weathered by the sea into an instrument — the most mournful instrument in the ocean. You try to listen, but nothing happens.)

dialogues.speaker: Outsider Shrine
dialogues.text: "Watch out behind you..."

dialogues.speaker: Outsider Shrine
dialogues.text: (Footsteps come from behind, clearly trying to remain unheard.)

dialogues.speaker: Outsider Shrine
dialogues.text: "Watch out!"

talks.objective: Find Washizu's lost possessions in Higi Village

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are you listening to me?

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: ...Please do not disturb me anymore.

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: "He" is unhappy. "He" is displeased with the disturbance caused by "words of the tongue," which drown out the wisdom of the "words of the heart."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "Words of the tongue"...?

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: The "words of the tongue" are like pouring rain. They shake the eardrums and disrupt the heart.

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: The "words of the heart" are like fog. They seep in naturally, enshrouding...

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: Shh...! "He" is listening. "He" is speaking.

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: Do not use your tongue. Do not use your ears. Listen with your heart...

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: Come here. Worship. Pray. And listen.

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: Remember, worship three times. Three times.

choices.text: Nod your head if you can speak.

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: Worship. Pray. Listen... Remember, remember.

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: Compared with "his" great blessings, this is but a small reward.

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: Pray. Worship. Listen to "him," and let "him" listen to you!

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: Then, like me, you will hear "his" words coming from your heart.

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: Then "he" will lead you out of suffering and grant you a great reward.

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: Remember. Worship three times a day and you will be rewarded.

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: Remember, remember.

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: "He" is coming! Don't stop worshiping! We must not stop worshiping!

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: "He" is sullen. "His" anger shall soon burst forth!

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: And why? Why, because of that woman! The one who refuses to pay tribute! The evil one!

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: She flees even now, but how can she escape him? Eighteen pairs of blood-red eyes! Thousands of sharp, venomous fangs! Countless mouths and numberless tongues, ever thirsting after blood!

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: She can't hide, she can't hide!

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: Ah, the desert nation of arid sentiment! And you, the foolish beggar who hides in the forest, claiming to be wise — none of you can protect her!

response.speaker: Washizu
response.text: You have the blessing! Go and worship! Go and worship!

choices.text: Oh yes, well said, good sir!
Oh yes, darn her, am I right?
Oh yes, it shall soon burst forth!

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: Hear me, please don't leave me...

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: You are here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: Thank you for forgiving my sins. Please let me return to you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you talking to me?

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: What... But why...

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: I presided over every sacrifice, and I accepted every one of your blessings!

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: But she, branded by you, established by your hand, has fled from your blessings. She has betrayed us!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you talking about...

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: Ah! Uh, sorry... Sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: I should not doubt "his" choice. Continue to endure, continue to worship...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you hear me?

dialogues.speaker: Washizu
dialogues.text: Continue to endure... Continue to worship...
